claim_locators.claim: The gnome segment combines HI, GET KEY and F3 repetitions; narration explains the three-wrong-guess fallback key.
Return then 6 on successive frames aims to stop toward the gnome screen's left side.
Return then 4 aims to stop toward the right of the giant screen, followed by the chest interaction.
The narration describes shield protection, the giant sleeping and subsequent chest pickup; sleeping position affects the approach.
The narration describes Return followed by the already-selected direction within 0.05 seconds as a fast stop.
